Inside Mutex

Staffing is a promise between two people.

A clinician who shows up ready, and a facility that is ready for them. Our job is to make that promise easy to keep, one match at a time.

Our mission

Close care gaps with people who care.

Every open shift is a patient waiting a little longer and a team stretched a little thinner. Every clinician between assignments is skill sitting idle. We exist to bring those two together quickly, and to do it properly.

That means showing the pay before anyone applies. It means verifying credentials at the source instead of taking a PDF on trust. And it means one recruiter who knows your name, whether you are the nurse taking the assignment or the manager who requested it.

We staff nursing, allied health, therapy, imaging, pharmacy, behavioral health, schools and healthcare IT across all 50 states.

Find a job Staffing for facilities

Why “Mutex”?

One opening. One right clinician. No collisions.

// in software, a mutex guarantees one owner at a time lock(shift) match = best_fit(clinician, unit) confirm(match) // never double-booked unlock(shift)

In computing, a mutex makes sure one thing has exactly one owner, so nothing gets dropped and nothing gets double-booked. We staff the same way: every opening gets one accountable recruiter and one clinician who truly fits it.

At a glance

Mutex Healthcare Staffing in six facts.

What we do
We are a healthcare staffing agency. We place clinicians on travel contracts, local contracts, per diem shifts and in permanent roles.
Who we serve
Nurses, therapists and allied health professionals looking for work, and the hospitals, clinics, schools and agencies that need them.
Specialties
Nursing, allied health, therapy, radiology and imaging, pharmacy, behavioral health, federal and schools, and healthcare IT.
Where we work
All 50 US states, from our head office in Frisco, Texas.
How we are different
Every job posting shows the pay before you apply, and one recruiter stays accountable for each match from first call to last shift.

Our values

Four things we will not trade away.

People first

Behind every requisition is a patient, and behind every résumé is a life. We make decisions as if both were in the room.

Transparency

Pay on the posting, terms in plain language, and bad news delivered as fast as good news.

Rigor

Credentials verified at the source, every time. A fast placement that fails an audit is not a placement.

Speed with care

Technology does the sorting so our recruiters can spend their time on the part that needs a human.

open jobs

Across travel, local, per diem and permanent roles, every one with pay shown.

All 50 states

From level I trauma centers to critical access hospitals and school districts.

One business day

The longest you will wait to hear back from a real person on our team.
